$comment: Signal K server settings for lcars-helm. Placeholders are replaced by deploy/provision.sh on the Pi and by scripts/setup-dev-signalk.mjs during development. The two differ only in the host names, so what runs on the bench is what runs on the boat.

subOptions.$comment: Seconds of silence before the socket is treated as dead and reopened. The default is 60, which is a long time to stare at frozen instruments: when the boat's WiFi drops, TCP does not notice, so Signal K holds a half-open socket until this fires. A live NMEA 2000 bus produces traffic several times a second, so 20 seconds is far longer than any real gap while still recovering quickly. Reconnection itself then backs off to at most 5 seconds.
